transactions.description: Align H3 with Anti-Drift & Shortcut Robustness, noting downstream reservation
transactions.before_text: 3. transactions.description: Align H4 with Bounded Operational Budget Feasibility, preserving strict GPU memory caveat
transactions.before_text: 4. transactions.before_text: 5.
